program.name: Hip Volume
program.subject: Hips & adductors
program.blurb: Three hip days: loaded inner-thigh work, the hip flexors, then adductors with the glutes.
program.about: Strong hips across three days. Sumo deadlifts, side lunges and Cossack squats load the inner thighs; knee holds, leg raises and hip circles train the hip flexors; then Copenhagen planks and adductor work pair with bridges for the glutes. Straight sets throughout. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Loaded adductors / hip flexors / adductors & glutes
